newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes weak, backwardation returns.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes weak, backwardation returns.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended weaker on Monday, under pressure from sagging U.S. markets, but dealers said activity was very limited.
Jan gas oil closed $3.50 a tonne weaker at $211.50 while Feb Brent was 21 cents down at 1749 GMT, trading at $23.25 a barrel.

The Jan/Feb gas oil spread was $1 in backwardation, having slipped earlier in the day into a 50 cent contango. Dealers had attributed this weakness in the front spread to selling by one trading house in the morning.
"All the action on gas oil was this morning... it has been very quiet," one dealer said.
"As for Brent - there is not that much going on either. There is just about nobody in the pit... it has been a horrible market and a waste of time today as far as I am concerned."
Dealers said weakness in the U.S. was the main force driving IPE energy prices lower.

Feb NYMEX crude was weaker as bearish temperature forecasts took some of the strength out of heating oil prices, and the approach of crude and gas oil arbitrage cargoes from European markets dampened sentiment too.
